_comment: Template for tools/fetch_jobs.py, shared by the board and scheduler. Copy to scrape_config.json and edit for your market; the real file stays gitignored. LinkedIn guest access is personal-use and against its automation terms. Optional authenticated intake is disabled until configured.

ats._comment: Budgets for the on-demand ATS source. The company list, the per-company cooldown (min_interval_minutes) and every filter live in job_scraper/companies.json - deliberately not duplicated here, because two files disagreeing about a request bound is worse than one file holding it.
